name: Camp Thorpe
description_short: A residential camp in Goshen, Vermont, for teens and adults with developmental disabilities, with 12-day and 6-day sessions and a one-week day camp. Activities are adapted to each camper.
special_needs_notes: Serves campers from age 12 through older adults with developmental, intellectual and physical disabilities, at a ratio of three campers to one counselor. Camp does not provide 1:1 aides; a few campers per session may bring an outside aide for an extra fee. Medications must arrive in dose packing. A nurse is on site at all times.

refund_policy_summary: Cancel in writing at least 30 days before the session for a full refund minus the $50 deposit; after that and before the start, 50% back; under 14 days or after the start, no refund except for medical reasons. Refunds are processed at the end of August.
swim_waterfront_notes: Camp has a pool and a pond used for fishing and boating.
